scope: operator support claims, deployment guidance, commercial hypothesis, and retained demo artifacts

commands.assertions: Support matrix contains all five required platform rows; deployment, monetization, go-to-market, operations, quickstart, and troubleshooting sections exist; retained browser, shared saved-flow, and native companion demos are non-empty.

assertions: Unverified platform rows are explicitly labeled unverified and launch claims are deferred.
Deployment guidance records current Linux staging status and all remaining lifecycle/signing blockers.
Commercial material is an explicit hypothesis with an unpriced cost model and validation thresholds.
Operator guides and executable demo artifacts are retained for reproducible walkthroughs.
limitations: This receipt validates package completeness and claim discipline; it does not create buyer interviews, measured support cost, signing authority, or platform acceptance evidence.
